cohort: 22,569 infants who underwent routine ROP screening in Shenzhen Eye Hospital from March 2003 to September 2023.
finding: Combining risk factors such as birth weight, gestational age, gender, multiple births, and mode of delivery with AI in screening programs for ROP could achieve risk prediction of ROP and TR-ROP.
mod_finding: In the risk prediction of TR-ROP, reasonable performance can be achieved by using GA + BW + Gender + MD + MB.
